notes.title: 🛠️ Dev Update #2: New Ages, Player Trading, Steam Playtest and What’s Next
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][p]It’s been a little while since the first dev post, and we’ve got [b]a ton of exciting updates[/b] to share — so let’s dive right in![/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ssl4JIesGdI"]🕰️[/url] Four Ages, One Empire[/h3][p]I've now expanded the game to include [b]four fully playable eras[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Stone Age[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bronze Age[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Iron Age[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Classical Age[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Each brings new resources, buildings and wonders — and sets the stage for the future of [i]Idle Empires, next up, The Renaissance[/i]. If you’ve been testing the prototype, you’ll already know how progression is starting to shape up![/p][p][/p][h3]🌐 Multiplayer Foundations[/h3][p]Since the last update, I've added:[/p][list][*][p][b]Server support[/b] with [b]in-game chat[/b] so players can connect, discuss, and maybe brag a little.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player trading[/b], which just went live this past weekend! ⚖️ We’re still tuning it, so keep an eye out for a future post diving into how the system works and how you can make the most of it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🐛 Bug Fixes & QoL[/h3][p]I've been squashing bugs left and right and adding tons of [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] based on feedback. Fixing bugs, adding QoL and polish are important so that will be something that gets addressed before moving onto newer content.[/p][p][/p][h2]🔮 What’s Coming Next[/h2][h3]🧪 [b]Steam Playtest — Coming in July![/b][/h3][p]I'm planning to host a [b]Steam Playtest later in July[/b], opening up the game to a wider group of players. This will be your chance to jump in, try things out, and give feedback that directly shapes the future of the game.[/p][p]There will probably be [b]another Playtest after that[/b], as we keep refining and expanding the game — so if you miss the first, there’ll be another chance to join.[/p][p][/p][h3]🚀 Early Access on the Horizon[/h3][p]I'm starting to think seriously about launching into [b]Early Access, probably in the Autumn[/b]. The plan is to build momentum gradually: polish the core, release new content in waves, and bring in players who want to be part of the journey from the beginning.[/p][p][/p][h3]🌲 Tech Tree Overhaul[/h3][p]Right now, the tech tree is functional but basic — more of a checklist than a web of decisions. That’s going to change. I'm planning a [b]complete rework[/b] that makes progression more strategic, rewarding, and engaging, that's the plan any way.[/p][p]We’ll also be [b]releasing future ages one at a time[/b], allowing us to balance and refine each before moving on. And once all the ages are in...[/p][p][/p][h3]🌀 Prestige Layer 2: Coming Soon(ish)[/h3][p]With all the ages in place, I'll begin locking in the [b]second prestige layer[/b] — adding depth, challenge, and long-term goals for players who’ve mastered the initial climb.[/p][p]And after that? Who knows where [i]Idle Empires[/i] will go. There are a lot of possibilities — and I’d love for you to be part of the ride.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for following along — I'm excited to keep building, testing, and evolving the game with you. More posts coming soon![/p][p]Stay idle (but not too idle 😉),
— Vethon[/p]

notes.title: 🚧 Dev Update #1: Welcome to Our Journey!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Welcome to the very first development post for my game — and thank you for checking it out this early in the journey. Right now, I'm in the middle of a private prototype/MVP testing phase, and while there's still a long road ahead, I'm excited to start sharing the progress with you.

🔍 What I'm Working On
At this stage, I'm focused on testing and refining the core mechanics. Think of it as laying the foundation: getting the feel right, making sure the systems work as intended, and confirming the core experience is actually fun. I'm going to be experimenting, iterating, and learning a lot as we go.

If you're seeing this, it means you're already interested in the project — and that honestly means the world.

🧪 Private Testing, Public Goals
I'm keeping testing small for now to gather focused feedback. But don’t worry: once things stabilize, I plan to expand the circle and eventually open up to more players using Steams Playtest feature. Our goal is to build a community around the game early — not just to play, but to help shape where this game goes.

💬 So What’s Next
I'll be using this space to post updates regularly:

[list]
[*] Progress reports
[*] Behind-the-scenes looks
[*] Feature reveals
[/list]

I want to be as transparent as I can — making a game can be a daunting task, but it’s also incredibly exciting and rewarding.

👋 Stay in Touch
If you're curious, have feedback, or just want to say hi, feel free to drop a comment. I'm listening. You can also join the [url=https://discord.gg/bfBzRm9nPu]Discord[/url] if you want to follow along more closely.

Thanks for being part of the very beginning. This is just the start — and I can't wait to show you more soon.

— Vethon
